column1: # LOO eligibility for the C4 held-out cohort. Written before the cohort is planned, and
# deliberately NOT a change to tests/genotype_development_donors.tsv: that manifest is frozen,
# and its sha256 is bound both in the completed development campaign signature and as
# expected_donor_manifest_sha256 in the settings gate. Editing it would break a binding for a
# campaign that has already run, so eligibility is recorded here instead.
# HG00096 is INELIGIBLE for leave-one-out because it is the coordinate-reference donor: the
# campaign reference HG00096#1#haplotype1-0000024:31848049-32074186 IS one of its two P lines.
# Measured 2026-09-22 on the committed probe: loo-gfa accepts the donor and reports "removed 2
# paths"; the resulting graph has no reference path; genotype exits 0 with MODEL_INCOMPLETE and
# names the cause only in the unsuffixed status file; no K-arm status is written; evaluate then
# fails with "cannot read ...mosaic_status.tsv". Leave-one-out has no meaning for the donor that
# The cohort is NOT launched. This file records the eligible set; Sol rules on the scheme.
